var flow=new Flow(document.getElementById('render'));flow.setHue(.56);flow.setTimeScale(2);flow.setPersistence(.25);var level=0,hue=.56,speed=2;document.getElementById('quality').onclick=function(){level=(level+1)%3;flow.changeQualityLevel(level);this.textContent=['4千粒子','8千粒子','1.6万粒子'][level]};document.getElementById('color').onclick=function(){hue=(hue+.18)%1;flow.setHue(hue)};document.getElementById('speed').onclick=function(){speed=speed===2?0:2;flow.setTimeScale(speed);this.textContent=speed?'暂停':'继续'};document.getElementById('curl').onclick=function(){var n=Math.random()*.7+.1;flow.setPersistence(n)};
AtomSceneControls.attach([['向左环绕',()=>flow.orbit(-.2,0)],['向右环绕',()=>flow.orbit(.2,0)],['俯视一点',()=>flow.orbit(0,.15)],['仰视一点',()=>flow.orbit(0,-.15)]],'调整视角');
